# S1.6 — Land the resource-economics & accounting model (§8.2, R-2.1.6)

**Spec:** `spec/CANONICAL_SPEC.md` §8.2 (R-2.1.6) · §8.5 · ADR-0039/0040/0041 (as
amended) · ADR-0043 · **Ticket:** `docs/tickets/010_S1.6__budgets-accounting.md`
**Requirement ids stamped:** **R-2.1.6**
**Base:** `svitali/harnessharness-s1.5` (stacked) · **Stage:** 1 · **Live stage:**
offline-only

## Summary
Lands the canonical resource-economics & accounting model as a new **persistent**
crate `crates/hh-budget` — the single budget/accounting scheme every later ticket
consumes (CC1). The closed kernel dimension registry lives in `hh-ontology`
(`DimensionId` counters/gauges + `DerivedDimension` bound names, closed by
`DimensionKey = primary | derived`); `hh-hir`'s `validate` now refuses unknown
`Budget.dimensions` keys (**closes DF-S1.4-1**). The ledger-bound `Account` projects
the `control.budget.{allocated,reserved,consumed,released,exceeded,amended}` family
plus `control.decision` and `measurement.cost.attributed` into a rebuildable
`BudgetTree`: one root per run, `slice`/`pool` dynamic containment, affine
reservations (`claim = consumed + released`, `over_reservation` flagged never
refused), ancestor charge propagation, idempotent charges on
`(source_event, dimension)`, `cost_totals`/`accountability_report` (R-ACC-2/3).
Spend is always derived — `PricingTable` micro-unit rates with
provenance/confidence/coverage/derivation/`pricing_ref` on every `SpendRow`;
`NoPrice`/`MixedCurrency` are typed refusals, never zeros. Exhaustion E1–E5 lands
(decision-point enforcement, `exceeded`+`decision{stop}` pair, bounded grace,
soft-threshold reminders with compaction re-arm, gauge caps), plus `MatchSpec` with
the closed M1/M2/M3 refusal sum and the evolution-context `budget_delta =
loosening` governance gate. `hh-baseline`'s throwaway `BudgetNode` is now a thin
adapter over `hh_budget` types — charges post exclusive primary token roles and
`tokens.blended` evaluates as the derived bound.

**Closes DF-S1.4-1** (bookkeeping repair: the row was referenced in code but never
appended — appended and closed this run). **Opens DF-S1.6-1** (E1 `read_only`
exemption refines when the effect risk class lands at S1.7).

## What changed
- **`crates/hh-budget/`** (new, persistent; deps wire/identity/provenance/ontology/
  ledger/hir): `quantity` (integer-only `ResourceQuantity`/`ResourceVector`/`Money`
  micro-units, ppm coverage), `usage` (`UsageMapping` dialects, `decompose` →
  exclusive `TokenDecomposition`, `hh-inclusive/1` `TokenVector` view), `attribution`
  (`charged_to ∈ {subject, instrument}`, cache attribution, R-ACC-3 producer table),
  `pricing` (`PricingTable`/`SpendRow`/`price`/`attribute_spend`), `spec` (ceilings,
  thresholds, grace, `BudgetNode`, affine `Reservation`), `events` (payload
  builders + decoders), `tree` (pure fold/projection), `account` (the ledger-bound
  ops incl. `check`/`exhaust`/`claim_grace`/`advise`/`resolve_ask`/`amend`/
  `attribute_spend`/`totals`/`accountability_report`), `matchspec`, `governance`.
- **`crates/hh-ontology/`** — new `dimensions` module: the closed registry
  (`DimensionId`, `DimensionClass`, `DimensionKey`, `DerivedDimension`,
  `RegisteredDimension`).
- **`crates/hh-hir/`** — `validate` checks `Budget.dimensions` keys against the
  registry (`SchemaViolation` on unknown); `validate_matrix` test + corpus fixture
  spellings canonicalized.
- **`crates/hh-ledger/`** — class table: `control.budget.*` (6), `control.decision`,
  `measurement.cost.attributed`, `verification.validator.invoked` + context rows
  (kernel-origin, ledger durability, not audit-grade); `Store` accessors
  (`alloc_id`/clock/head) the `Account` mints through.
- **`crates/hh-baseline/`** — `budget.rs` thin adapter over `hh_budget`
  (`BudgetSpec`/`ResourceVector`/`DimensionKey`); `control.rs` charges the exclusive
  primary roles; `trace.rs` buckets canonical role names for the CC3 totals check.
- **Build memory:** `docs/adr/ADR-0236`, `ADR-0237` (+ regenerated index);
  `docs/tickets/DEFERRALS.md` — DF-S1.4-1 DONE, DF-S1.6-1 OPEN;
  `docs/build/runs/S1.6.md`.

## Design decisions
- Dimension registry homed in `hh-ontology` so `hh-hir` closes DF-S1.4-1 with no
  layering inversion; `hh-budget` re-exports (CC7).
- `DimensionKey` splits bound keys (primary | derived) from charge keys (primary
  only); `tokens.blended` stays a legal bound while never a stored counter.
- Refusals ledger on the same closed classes via `outcome`/`refusal` members;
  reservations are affine; E1 is conservative pending the risk-class field;
  reminder dedup rides `context.observation.recorded`. Full rationale: ADR-0236/0237.
